title: Ivo and the Will
author: X. M. Marchetti
blurb: Emrys Yarrow, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
